verdict.rationale: Law firms can plausibly ship self-serve document-assembly tools for founders, so this axis applies. However, the evidence describes only lawyer-led drafting ('structuring, negotiating and drafting all documentation'). The internal technologies it mentions (AI, automated translation, a blockchain-based trading platform) are adjacent tools, not interactive online document assembly that clients complete themselves.

support.subject: As a founder, the firm ships self-serve document automation — interactive assembly of real legal documents I can complete online, not just static templates
